p: voice: The prophet teaches us by his example to flee to God for help in our necessities.
troubled: He shows that we must patiently abide though God does not deliver us from our troubles at the first cry.
waking: Meaning that his sorrows were as watchmen that kept his eyes from sleeping.
song in the night: Of thanksgiving, which I was accustomed to sing in my prosperity.
diligent search: Both the reasons why I was chastened, and when my sorrows would end.
mercy clean gone for ever: As if he would say, It is impossible: by which he exhorts himself to patience.
infirmity: Though I first doubted of my life, yet considering that God had his years, that is, change of times, and was accustomed also to lift up them whom he had beaten, I took heart again.
in the sanctuary: That is in heaven, to which we must ascend by faith, if we will know the ways of God.
God as our God: He condemns all who worship anything save the only true God, whose glory appears through the world.
waters saw thee: He declares how the power of God was declared when he delivered the Israelites through the Red Sea.
sound: That is, thundered and lightninged.
known: For when you had brought over your people, the water returned to her course, and the enemies who thought to have followed them, could not pass through, Ex 14:28,29.
